objective1.dial: The truce is in pieces. Factions are splintering. We need to secure our communications before the network fractures completely.

objective2.dial: Routing power... The relay is damaged.

objective3.dial: The bluepills must remain asleep! Destroy the relay!

objective4.dial: Communications restored. But we are picking up strange signals.

objective6.dial: The fractures are deep. It's not just Zion... the Machines are fighting themselves.
